description: Header file defining the class 'upper_phy_rx_symbol_handler_printer_decorator', which decorates a symbol handler to add logging and file output capabilities for received symbols and PRACH windows in a radio communication system.

classes.name: upper_phy_rx_symbol_handler_printer_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for handling received symbols and PRACH windows, adding logging and file output functionalities.

methods.name: handle_rx_symbol
methods.description: Handles a received symbol, logs and writes the symbol data to a file if conditions are met.

methods.name: handle_rx_prach_window
methods.description: Handles a PRACH window, logs and writes PRACH samples to a file if enabled.
